geometry: B separate swept locks are preserved exactly in bare Taper. The side fade grows upward by increasing its normalized span0.30 to0.38; its lower boundary and footprint are unchanged. Curly top retains its existing crown and uses the same side treatment. Other models, body/face/clothing, headgear shapes, palettes and fixed studio are retained.
rendering: Side coverage is opacity from a neutral RGB/alpha texture under BLEND, not transmission or refraction. Longer hair is OPAQUE. A nearest-opaque portrait prototype cannot reproduce partial side coverage without alpha compositing or an equivalent faithful baked solution. Do not substitute254 modeled fibers. Ordinary GLBs contain no compression or quantization.
controls: Independent feature/color controls remain. Compare B original fade is available for bare Taper, with a matching Ombré baseline. It is mutually exclusive with Compare254 and clears when choosing an unsupported hair/headgear state. Hair and facial-hair recoloring retain current palette behavior.
